title: Publish and recover selected architecture snapshots
description: Publish a prepared derived snapshot within an explicitly selected owned output boundary and recover interruptions without overwriting unrelated content or misreporting commitment.
inputs: Validated complete candidate, expected current-output identity and explicit output selection.
Output ownership and writer-exclusion evidence, plus any retained interrupted-publication state.
outputs: Published snapshot identity and actual committed/uncommitted/recovery-required outcome.
Retained earlier readable versions and precise conflict or recovery diagnostics.
behavior: Reject input/output overlap, symlink escape, unrelated output ownership and stale expected output before publication.
Exclude competing writers and prepare an immutable version beneath the owned output; never update assets in the currently readable version.
Switch the single entry file only after candidate completeness and durable preparation are established; that switch defines commitment.
After interruption, inspect exact entry and candidate identities before recovery; never blindly replay stale intent or overwrite a competing writer.
Preserve the earlier version and report post-commit reporting failures as committed rather than rolling back an acknowledged result.
Perform no external upload, model mutation, automatic history export or automatic deletion of prior versions.

failure_behavior.condition: Validation, preparation or expected-current checks fail.
failure_behavior.outcome: Leave the prior readable version and unrelated content unchanged.

failure_behavior.condition: Commitment cannot be established after interruption.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report recovery required, preserve candidate/previous bytes and block replacement until explicit reconciliation.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
